scope: Conditional population comparison for initial survivors through sealed b004; not the 73 later-selected dossiers.

null_controls.survivor_definition: Any automatic-triage survivor on a host; vetting errors count as survivors

real_run_snapshot.snapshot_limits: The survey is live; search, completion, vet and retention frontiers are asynchronous. Saved counters are retained without asserting final population completeness.

comparison.interpretation: If the transformed null controls represent the survey background, roughly one third of initial survivors could be noise/stellar-variability false alarms before eclipsing binaries. The upper endpoint cannot rule out most or all.
limits: Transfer from finite transformed controls to the real population is an assumption, not established exchangeability.
The rate ratio is a conditional population comparison, not a calibrated individual false-alarm probability or astrophysical FPP.
Eclipsing binaries, blends and other astrophysical contaminants require separate assessment.
This is an asynchronous live-run snapshot; it is not a final survey rate.
This is not a measured contamination fraction for the 73 dossiers selected after further vetting.
